params.caption: 🕹️ Xbox 25th Anniversary Series X restock sells out almost instantly Microsoft released another limited batch of the transparent-green 25th Anniversary Xbox Series X this week, and it is already gone. Resellers on eBay are listing it at next-gen console prices, and fans who missed out are criticising Xbox’s first-come, first-served approach. 🕒 Nov 13, 2026 · 16:27 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: GameSpot 👥 @Xbox 😤 Did you get one?
